summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its U.S. equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K announced selection of its Ferrovial-led DriveTN consortium, with Transurban and Tikehau Star Infra, as preferred developer of Tennessee's I-24 Southeast Choice Lanes, a 26-mile Nashville-Murfreesboro P3. The consortium will finance, design, build, operate and maintain the project valued at $9.2 billion, described as Tennessee's first public-private partnership and largest private investment; projected concession value to the state is $24.8 billion. No board recommendation, advisor, financing terms, ownership split or regulatory timetable was disclosed. Watch final concession execution and financial close as the arbitrage-relevant milestones.
